name: The model leaks a name, the client, a ticket and a figure; only the clean statement survives

reads.title: Design review | Northwind Traders
reads.text:
Helena Brandt 11:02 Can you walk us through why the onboarding has 7 screens? Marketing at Northwind wants it down to 3.
Sardor 11:05 Sure. In Figma I mapped every field to the step where we first need it. 4 of the 7 screens only exist because billing details are asked up front. If we defer billing until the first invoice, the flow drops to 3 screens and nothing is lost.
Helena Brandt 11:07 That is much clearer than the deck. Oskar, can you check with finance?
Oskar Lind 11:08 Will do, ticket DSN-208 is tracking it.
Sardor 11:10 I will post the revised prototype with 3 variants and the drop-off numbers, 41 percent on screen 5.

gate.activity_summary: Explained a design decision and proposed a shorter flow.

evidence.statement: Explained to Helena why the onboarding flow was long and how deferring billing would shorten it.
Mapped every onboarding field for Northwind to the step that first needs it and proposed a shorter flow.
Tracked the redesign under DSN-208 and prepared revised prototype variants for a follow-up design review.
Presented drop-off of forty one percent on one screen to justify deferring billing details in the flow.
Explained a long onboarding flow by mapping each field to where it was first needed and proposed a shorter one.
